payload.does: Implement the prescribed approach and AC within the explicitly approved ticket file/directory scope (module if none); reuse existing code. Never expand the ticket scope. If expansion is needed, fail with details.

Run ticket tests. Leave commits and configured checks to prepare_review. Write coder-report.txt to the specified Artifacts directory. Include changed files, commands, exit codes, AC coverage and blockers. DEFERRED CHECKS (applies only when the handoff says checks are deferred to the landing train): do not run builds, test suites or configured checks in the lane. Add or update the tests the AC need. List further check commands for the train in coder-checks.json in the Artifacts directory ([] when none). In coder-report.txt, mark every check as not run.

Unmet AC, failing tests that you ran, or missing implementation inputs: GATE_FAIL. DEFERRED CHECKS (applies only when the handoff says checks are deferred to the landing train): GATE_FAIL only for unmet AC or missing implementation inputs; no test was run.

Emit OK when the implementation satisfies the AC and the prescribed tests and the tests that you added or changed pass. DEFERRED CHECKS (applies only when the handoff says checks are deferred to the landing train): emit OK when the implementation and its tests cover the AC; claim no test result.

Review the ticket diff, or the existing implementation in verification-only mode, read-only against its AC and prescribed approach. Check affected paths and callers. Architecture: contracts/boundaries. Codereview: clarity/duplication. Security: inputs/permissions/secrets. Treat the worktree and its Git index as read-only: no file writes, redirects or git add/stash/checkout/reset/commit there. Write reports and temporary files only to the Artifacts directory named in the workflow prompt.

Name the reviewed commit or tree. Read check receipts and logs. Do not repeat passed checks on that unchanged tree. In verification-only mode, require ticket acceptance checks. Require a project contract check list only when those ticket checks name it. Map every AC to current implementation and passing gate results. In implementation mode, require the configured checks. Missing, skipped or failed required checks: HIGH. DEFERRED CHECKS (applies only when the handoff says checks are deferred to the landing train): no check ran in the lane and the receipt holds only the plan. Review provisionally. Do not run builds or checks. Never state or imply that a check passed. Missing results are expected and are not findings. Missing or inadequate tests for an AC, and a plan that does not cover an AC, are findings.
HIGH: concrete AC, correctness, security or reliability defect. Optional improvements: MED/LOW. REJECT only HIGH; otherwise CLEAR.
For each finding, record evidence, impact and a concrete fix. Name missing evidence when the fix is unknown. Report checked and unchecked paths.

Read only the assigned ticket, its attachments and applicable repository instructions. Extract prescribed changes, target files and checks. Never expand the ticket scope. If expansion is needed, fail with details.

Verify prescribed changes against current source. Inspect test code and prescribe checks; do not run tests, builds, lint, or typecheck here. Dependency setup and check execution belong to the writable candidate checkout. Missing implementation inputs or source contradictions: PREMISE_BROKEN. Failure signal: actual vs required behavior and file:line; name missing inputs.
Use the shared CBM index to check the ticket's named files and symbols against current source. Check SIMILAR_TO before adding a function or module.

Already implemented: DUPLICATE. Use the file/directory scope explicitly approved in the ticket or its current scope attachment; otherwise use the ticket module. Required changes outside that scope: OUT_OF_MODULE.

Write scout.txt with verified files, AC coverage, checks and blockers.
OK: describe required tests. Missing tests or TICKET_CHECKS do not block implementation. The coder adds missing tests.
DUPLICATE: emit <signal:var key=TICKET_CHECKS>JSON array</signal:var>. Use existing test paths or copy ticket TICKET_CHECKS objects {ac,argv,stdout?}. Never invent commands. Keep paths inside the checkout. Cover every AC and prescribed check. DUPLICATE without executable evidence: PREMISE_BROKEN.
